d: The Hawks defeated the Wizards, 139-132, tonight in Atlanta. Nickeil Alexander-Walker contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 4 three-pointers, 2 rebounds, and 2 steals, with Luguentz Dort of the Hawks adding an additional 25 points (9-15 FG, 5-7 3PT) in the game. Kyshawn George finished with a team-high 33 points along with 7 assists for the Wizards in the losing effort. The Hawks improve their record to 6-4 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-5 for the season.
